description: Screen real-yield DeFi liquidity pools across Aave, Aerodrome, Uniswap, and other protocols. Pass optional `chain` (default `base`; use `all` for multi-chain pools >= $5M TVL), `asset` filter (e.g. `USDC`, `WETH`), and `min_tvl_usd`. Returns ranked `pools[]` with `project`, `symbol`, `apy`, `apy_base`, `apy_reward`, and `tvl_usd`. Do not use for prediction markets (use get_polymarket_markets) or token security checks (use check_evm_token_risk). 1 free try per IP, then HTTP 402 ($0.005 USDC).

session_token.description: Optional prepaid x402s_... session token from open_agent_session or https://apix402data.com/pay used after the 1 free try rolls over to HTTP 402.

timeout_ms.description: Optional deadline in ms. If the local LLM would exceed it, the response comes back fast with "degraded": true and non-LLM/cached data

name: get_defi_yield_pools
title: Cross-chain DeFi real-yield & liquidity matrix
